title: Job: The Electricity Bill
story: Job brief from the housing society: the first 100 units are free, units 101 to 200 cost ₹3 each, and every unit above 200 costs ₹6. There is a fixed charge of ₹50 whenever any units were used.
goal: Write bill(units) returning the amount in rupees.
hints: Charge each slab separately: how many units fall inside it?
Units in the middle slab: min(units, 200) - 100. Units in the top slab: units - 200.
socratic: How many units are charged at ₹3 when usage is 150?
Why can't you just multiply all units by one price?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Job: The Electricity Bill”?
